column1: # The closed list behind `ssh iumac auto-run` (scripts/iumac-gate.sh, run on the MacBook): command lines that run with no dialog
# once the owner has granted their class there (`human-queue.sh consent grant <class>`; a row is inert until then).
# One row per command line: <class><TAB><command template><TAB><needs: none|biometric|active><TAB><time limit, seconds>.
# A request's command must equal a template byte for byte; the variable parts are the slot <N> (1 to 4 digits) and the slot <ID> (an account id, [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}).
# `biometric` = the command raises a 1Password prompt, so the gate runs it only on an unlocked screen (exit 75 otherwise,
# the request stays pending). `active` = the command opens something on the screen, so the gate runs it only while the MacBook
# is in use: unlocked and input within IUMAC_GATE_ACTIVE_MAX seconds (exit 75 otherwise, nothing runs). Several rows may share a class (variants of one shape). Add a row only for a shape that
# repeats with no refusal; never sudo, a restart, the deploy gate's release, a recursive delete, hc server/hc update.
# The factory mirrors the class names in domains/checkpoints/triage.ts: add them in both. A row reaches the MacBook with
